decisions.reason: As a flagship waterproof line close to the core offer in a growing industry, it likely meets aspirations, and the firm's slack lets it keep the line despite limited evidence after 2019.

ESD occupational shoes are a standard requirement in industrial channels and sit close to the established offer, so there is no clear shortfall that would trigger problemistic search to redeploy the resources.
A multi-model safety series in the core business is likely performing at aspiration in a growing market, though footwear collections are refreshed regularly, so some risk remains that it is replaced.
